title: Senior .Net Technical Architect
jobDescription: Senior .NET Solutions Architect (Lending & Fintech) Role Overview We are seeking a visionary Senior .NET Solutions Architect to lead the design and evolution of our flagship 360-degree loan processing platform. This is a high-impact role focused on building a scalable, multi-tenant Saa S product that manages the entire lending lifecycle—from customer onboarding and credit appraisal to disbursement and recovery. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in cloud-native architecture, high-concurrency microservices, and secure multi-tenant data isolation. You will be responsible for defining the technical roadmap, ensuring high availability on Azure, and mentoring a high-performing engineering team. Key Responsibilities Architectural Leadership: Design and maintain a modular, multi-tenant Saa S architecture using .NET 8/9+ and microservices patterns. Security & Identity: Implement robust authentication and authorization strategies using Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), specifically managing B2B workflows for internal staff and B2C for customer-facing portals. Infrastructure as Code (Ia C): Lead the provisioning of cloud resources using Terraform, ensuring environment parity across Dev, UAT, and Production. Integration Excellence: Design seamless communication between services using Azure Service Bus and Azure Integration Services (Logic Apps, API Management) to connect with external credit bureaus and payment gateways. Dev Ops & Orchestration: Manage containerized workloads on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) or high-scale Azure App Services, ensuring CI/CD excellence via Git. Data Modeling: Architect high-performance schemas in SQL Server, implementing data isolation strategies (e.g., database-per-tenant or schema-per-tenant) to ensure regulatory compliance and performance. Technical Qualifications Core Frameworks: Mastery of .NET Core / .NET 6+ and C#. Cloud Platform: Hands-on experience with Azure (Compute, Storage, Networking, and Monitoring). Microservices: Proven experience with Distributed Systems, Sagas, Event Sourcing, and Outbox patterns. Infrastructure: Proficiency with Terraform and container orchestration (Docker/K8s). Messaging: Deep understanding of asynchronous messaging via Azure Service Bus or NATS. Identity: Practical experience configuring Entra ID (B2B/B2C), OAuth2, and Open ID Connect. Database: Advanced T-SQL, performance tuning, and designing multi-tenant data architectures. Preferred Experience Background in Fintech, Banking, or Lending domains (Loan Origination, Servicing, or Credit Scoring). Experience with Domain-Driven Design (DDD) and Clean Architecture. Knowledge of compliance standards (e.g., SOC2, GDPR, or local financial regulations). Experience with front-end integration (Angular, React, or Flutter) for a true 360-degree user experience. Soft Skills Strategic Thinking: Ability to balance immediate feature delivery with long-term technical debt management. Communication: Capable of explaining complex architectural trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders. Mentorship: A passion for code reviews, architectural workshops, and fostering a culture of engineering excellence.
